links.comparator_used: Model-embedded uncertainty (each model's own uncertainty) versus a decoupled XGBoost-residual selector; abstention at ~20% coverage compared with predicting on all cases
links.outcome: Selective prediction performance (test AUC at ~20% coverage) with abstention on uncertain cases
links.effect: With the decoupled XGBoost residual selector, all five models achieved selective prediction at approximately 20% coverage (test AUC 0.90, 95% CI 0.85-0.95); model-embedded uncertainty succeeded only for XGBoost
links.tradeoff: Abstains on approximately 80% of cases, which are routed to human evaluation; only about 20% coverage is automated
links.quote: Model-embedded uncertainty succeeded only for XGBoost; with the decoupled XGBoost residual selector, all five models achieved selective prediction at approximately 20% coverage (test AUC 0.90, 95% CI 0.85-0.95), abstaining on approximately 80% of cases for individual safety.

design_hint: selective prediction with abstention and routing to human evaluation
